ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (dark) pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized at the distal tips and along linear scar trajectories.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity contiguous blobs located at the distal tips of the left and right lobes. The transition zones exhibit high-frequency mottling. The remainder of the fluke is a low-intensity contiguous field with scattered micro-intensity points.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a central angle of approximately 45 degrees and high bounding-box depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present across the entire trailing edge from notch to tips; serrations appear as sharp, irregular peaks isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a concave curve from the median notch to the tips, while leading edges display a convex outward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (2-10 pixels in diameter) scattered across the dark regions, specifically concentrated on the lower-central fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned white linear streaks; notable multi-parallel rake mark patterns visible on the left lobe and distal sections of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white rake marks and circular scars resulting in a highly textured surface pigmentation; no visible physical amputations.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast mottling pattern where white pigmentation meets the dark surface at the lobe tips.
